Display Views — Matrix

Matrix — Prioritize by instinct.

Tasks are automatically placed on Eisenhower's 4 quadrants by urgency x importance. See at a glance which one to tackle first.

Eisenhower's 4 quadrants

Tasks are auto-plotted by urgency (how close the deadline is) x importance (priority)

Priority is instantly clear from gem colors

Ruby red (high) / Amber yellow (medium) / Sapphire blue (low). Star size = planned effort

Click a Quadrant for a Task List

Shown in the right panel with the issue key, in the same gem color

Never second-guess your priorities.

Just open the Matrix and your tasks are auto-plotted into 4 quadrants. Start with the top-right quadrant and work your way down.

Backlog My Tasks

A Chrome extension that lets you check and manage your assigned Backlog tasks across multiple spaces in one place. 8 views and a project dashboard make daily task management and team progress tracking easier.
